**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mrs Sumner](../persons.html#1381)
I shall be very happy to come to luncheon on Thursday Please do not wait for me if I am a few minutes late for I shall not be able to set off till 12.30, and the roads may be as bad as they are today!

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to Mrs Sumner/ The Close/ Winchester and postmarked Winchester 10 January 1887.
